The NATS receiver receives traces, metrics, and logs from a NATS messaging system.

## Configuration

The following configuration options are supported:

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `endpoint` | string | `nats://localhost:4222` | The NATS client connection URL. |
| `queue_group` | string | `""` | Optional queue group for load-balancing traces and logs across collector replicas. |
| `auth` | object | `{}` | Authentication parameters (supports username/password, token, nkey, credentials_file). |
| `tls` | object | `{}` | TLS client configuration (`ca_file`, `cert_file`, `key_file`, `insecure_skip_verify`, etc.). |
| `monitor` | object | `{}` | HTTP client configuration for `/varz` and `/jsz` scraping (`endpoint`, `timeout`, `tls`, etc.). |
| `monitor_url` | string | `""` | Backward-compatible HTTP monitoring endpoint of NATS server (e.g. `http://localhost:8222`). |
| `scrape_interval` | duration | `5s` | The time interval between metrics scrapings. |
| `tapped_subjects` | []string | `["telemetry.>", "events.>", "orders.>"]` | Subjects tapped to construct trace spans from messages. |

### Example Configurations

#### Default
```yaml
receivers:
  nats:
    endpoint: nats://localhost:4222
```

#### Production Enterprise Configuration
```yaml
receivers:
  nats:
    endpoint: nats://nats.production:4222
    queue_group: "otelcol-nats-cluster"
    auth:
      username: "otel-collector"
      password: "${env:NATS_PASSWORD}"
      credentials_file: "/etc/nats/user.creds"
    tls:
      ca_file: "/etc/ssl/certs/nats-ca.pem"
      cert_file: "/etc/ssl/certs/client-cert.pem"
      key_file: "/etc/ssl/certs/client-key.pem"
    monitor:
      endpoint: "https://nats.production:8222"
      timeout: 10s
      tls:
        insecure_skip_verify: false
        ca_file: "/etc/ssl/certs/nats-ca.pem"
    scrape_interval: 10s
    tapped_subjects:
      - "telemetry.>"
      - "events.>"
      - "orders.>"
```

## Metrics

The following metrics are recorded by the NATS receiver:

| Metric | Type | Unit | Description | Attributes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `nats.server.connections` | Gauge | `{connection}` | Current active client connections | `nats.server.id`, `messaging.system` |
| `nats.server.slow_consumers` | Gauge | `{consumer}` | Total slow consumers detected by NATS server | `nats.server.id`, `messaging.system` |
| `nats.server.memory` | Gauge | `By` | NATS server memory usage in bytes | `nats.server.id`, `messaging.system` |
| `messaging.client.consumed.messages` | Sum (Monotonic) | `{message}` | Total messages received/consumed by NATS server | `nats.server.id`, `messaging.system` |
| `messaging.client.sent.messages` | Sum (Monotonic) | `{message}` | Total messages delivered/sent by NATS server | `nats.server.id`, `messaging.system` |
| `nats.server.in_bytes` | Sum (Monotonic) | `By` | Total inbound bytes received by NATS server | `nats.server.id`, `messaging.system` |
| `nats.server.out_bytes` | Sum (Monotonic) | `By` | Total outbound bytes sent by NATS server | `nats.server.id`, `messaging.system` |
| `nats.jetstream.streams` | Gauge | `{stream}` | Total JetStream streams configured | `nats.server.id`, `messaging.system` |
| `nats.jetstream.consumers` | Gauge | `{consumer}` | Total JetStream consumers configured | `nats.server.id`, `messaging.system` |
| `nats.jetstream.messages` | Gauge | `{message}` | Total JetStream stored messages | `nats.server.id`, `messaging.system` |
| `nats.jetstream.bytes` | Gauge | `By` | Total JetStream storage bytes used | `nats.server.id`, `messaging.system` |

## Logs

The receiver automatically listens to `$SYS.>` and `$JS.EVENT.ADVISORY.>` subjects and transforms them into OpenTelemetry LogRecords with structured attributes, appropriate severity mapping (`INFO`, `WARN`, `ERROR`), and semantic domain `nats`.

## Traces

The receiver taps configured messaging subjects and extracts distributed context via standard W3C `traceparent` headers using `carrier.HeaderCarrier`. Tapped messages generate consumer spans adhering to OpenTelemetry Semantic Conventions for Messaging v1.26+.
